task_summary: Extract keyframes from a Super Mario gameplay video, convert to grayscale, count coins/enemies/turtles via template matching, and output results to CSV
decomposition_rationale: The task follows a linear pipeline with three distinct functional concerns: (1) video frame extraction and grayscale conversion, (2) template-based object counting with NMS, and (3) CSV result generation. However, since these are tightly coupled steps in a single pipeline and the task is straightforward, decomposing into 2 skills—one for video/image processing and one for template matching and counting—provides clean separation without over-decomposition.

skills.name: evo-video-keyframe-extraction
skills.description: Extracts keyframes from an MP4 video at uniform temporal intervals using OpenCV VideoCapture, saves them with sequential naming (keyframes_001.png, keyframes_002.png, etc.), and converts them in-place from RGB/BGR to grayscale.
skills.responsibility: Video decoding, metadata extraction (FPS, frame count), uniform temporal sampling for keyframe selection, saving keyframes to disk with zero-padded naming, and in-place grayscale conversion of saved frames.
dr_sections: 2. RGB to Grayscale Conversion with OpenCV

skills.name: evo-template-matching-counter
skills.description: Counts occurrences of template objects (coins, enemies, turtles) in grayscale keyframe images using OpenCV matchTemplate with TM_CCOEFF_NORMED and Non-Maximum Suppression, then aggregates results into a CSV file via Pandas.
skills.responsibility: Loading grayscale template images, performing template matching against each keyframe, applying NMS to deduplicate detections, counting objects per frame per category, and writing the final CSV with columns frame_id/coins/enemies/turtles.
